title: Korolevskiy Theater RTX
notes: From the companion's theater_rtx.lua: AgX with the punchy look and a fixed exposure, blue heterogeneous stage haze, bloom, coloured shadows through glass; $color and $color2 to white on the 144 PBR atlases (the vanilla grade passes 1.0 and wraps in the renderer's byte-sized texture factor); the base map's raster haze, bloom and stage-mist sheets off in RTX (the sheets formed an opaque wall there).
000_theater_rtx_config_baseline.lua is left out: it undid the Astra loader's process-local config copy, which the native loader never makes.
The sky: rtx.skyMode 0 (the map's own skybox); the companion's physical sky and weather would replace the stage haze.

shell.note: The theater's mesh has no ground beside and under the stage; a camera there (noclip) saw the skybox, a uniform navy (31 48 88) Remix lights as sky (lavender). The mesh spans -1986.5 -1841.3 -182.6 to 1998.6 4182.2 2242.8 (its collision, the same triangles), the skybox box 128 units further out on every side; the shell is halfway. Its colour, measured in the field game 2026-11-09: the sky's navy came out saturated blue there (lit like the floor's underside), 20 20 22 a dark ground.
